# Frontguard

> Open-source frontend visual regression testing for web teams, with optional model-assisted review.

Frontguard is an open-source CLI with pre-release cloud components. The CLI is MIT-licensed and free forever. Hosted plans are not generally available and have no published purchase price.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://frontguard.dev) — Product overview, install paths, comparison vs Percy / Chromatic / Argos

## For Agents

- [Agent task routing](https://frontguard.dev/agents.md) — Start here for MCP tools, cloud API routes, auth, limits, and safe task ordering
- [OpenAPI contract](https://frontguard.dev/openapi.json) — Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the pre-release cloud API; there is no live default hosted endpoint yet
- [MCP discovery manifest](https://frontguard.dev/.well-known/mcp.json) — Discovery for `@frontguard/mcp`; point `FRONTGUARD_API_URL` at a verified deployment

## What Frontguard Does

- Configurable consensus — projects can opt into multiple captures per route; pixel comparison uses SSIM as a fallback
- Optional AI classification — screenshot evidence, basic route metadata, and optional accessibility findings go directly to the configured OpenAI or Anthropic provider
- Experimental fixes — CSS suggestions and sandbox verification are separate opt-ins; unverified suggestions remain labeled
- Plugin architecture — nine lifecycle hooks; built-ins for accessibility (axe-core), Figma compare, perf budgets, monitor, third-party-script drift
- CI-ready — generated workflows preserve JSON and HTML artifacts; source PR reporting remains pending external release validation, and remote thumbnails require a configured `imageUpload` backend
- Cloud source included — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 implementation is in the repository; hosted and Docker onboarding are pre-release

## Installation

### CLI

```bash
npm install @frontguard/cli
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard init
```

App terminal (leave running; use your project's command, such as the example below, and wait for the generated `baseUrl`):

```bash
npm run dev
```

Frontguard terminal (uses the generated config):

```bash
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard doctor
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard update-baselines
git push origin frontguard-baselines # before CI comparisons
npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard run
```

### Playwright plugin

```bash
npm install -D @frontguard/cli @frontguard/playwright
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { visualTest } from '@frontguard/playwright';

test('checkout @ 375px', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/checkout');
  const result = await visualTest(page, 'checkout');
  expect(result.passed).toBe(true);
});
```

### GitHub Action

External consumer smoke is pending, so no public copy-ready Action workflow is
published yet. Use the CLI flow above until the release procedure in
`docs/ops-actions.md` passes.

---

## Configuration

`frontguard.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from '@frontguard/cli';

export default defineConfig({
  baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000',
  viewports: [375, 768, 1440],
  browsers: ['chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit'],
  antiFlakeRenders: 3,
  ai: { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-4o' },
  outputDir: '.frontguard/results',
});
```

### Environment variables

- `FRONTGUARD_OPENAI_KEY` / `FRONTGUARD_ANTHROPIC_KEY` — AI provider key. The Playwright plugin also accepts unprefixed `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` when present. `frontguard doctor` reads exactly the same names the runtime reads.
- `FRONTGUARD_API_URL` / `FRONTGUARD_API_KEY` — a verified self-hosted or future hosted cloud endpoint.

---

## Pricing

- **Free CLI** — $0 forever, MIT, optional BYO AI, local reports, configurable consensus, and git-orphan baselines.
- **Hosted (planned; not generally available)** — design-partner waitlist only. No purchase price, production onboarding, or hosted baseline promotion is available.
- **Enterprise (planned)** — no generally available enterprise service or SLA today.

---

## Comparison

Pulled from each vendor's documented pricing and release notes; full sources in `docs/research.md`.

| Feature | Frontguard | Percy | Chromatic | Argos |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free tier | CLI free forever (MIT, BYO AI key) | 5,000 screenshots/mo | 5,000 snapshots/mo · Chrome-only · no a11y | 5,000 screenshots/mo · unlimited Playwright traces |
| Hosted entry | Waitlist | Desktop ≈ $199/mo | Starter $179/mo | Pro from $100/mo |
| Snapshot overage | n/a for local CLI | Quote-walled | $0.008 / snapshot | $0.004 extra screenshot |
| AI diff explanation | Plain-English category + confidence + cause | Visual Review Agent (NL summaries) | No diff-classification AI | Markets "no AI overhead" |
| Sandbox-verified fixes | Patch + re-render in local Playwright / Daytona | Not advertised | Not advertised | Not advertised |
| Self-host | Cloud source included; Compose onboarding pre-release | SaaS only | SaaS only | MIT, self-host possible from source |
| MCP server | @frontguard/mcp | Not shipped | Per-branch /mcp · Storybook 10.3+ · React | Not shipped |

---

## CI/CD examples

### GitHub Actions

```yaml
name: Visual Regression
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  visual:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm start & npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000
      - run: npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard run --url http://localhost:3000
```

The composite Action remains pre-release while external consumer smoke is
pending.

### GitLab CI

```yaml
visual:
  image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:focal
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run build
    - npm start &
    - npx -p @frontguard/cli frontguard run
  variables:
    FRONTGUARD_OPENAI_KEY: $OPENAI_KEY
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - .frontguard/results/
```

---

## MCP server

`@frontguard/mcp` exposes the following pre-release tools to in-IDE agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Copilot). There is no live default hosted endpoint, and `accept_baseline` currently records approval without promoting screenshots:

- `list_regressions(pr_id)`
- `get_suggested_fix(diff_id)`
- `accept_baseline(run_id, confirm_all_regressions_reviewed: true)` — run-scoped, not per-diff
- `recent_runs(repo, branch)`

```bash
npx -y @frontguard/mcp
```

Drop into `mcp.json` per the docs at https://frontguard.dev/docs/integrations/mcp.

---

## Self-host

Cloud source is included in `packages/cloud-api`, but its Compose path is not a verified clean-checkout onboarding flow yet. Treat it as development code, not a supported self-host quick start.

---

## FAQ

### How do I install Frontguard?

Install `@frontguard/cli`, run `frontguard init`, start the app in a separate terminal, wait for the generated config `baseUrl`, run `frontguard update-baselines`, push `frontguard-baselines`, then run `frontguard run` using that config.

### How does Frontguard handle cross-OS rendering differences?

Playwright's own docs warn rendering varies by OS and hardware. The renderer is currently repository-source-only, not a published image; its clean-clone build requires the documented npm build, `npm pack`, tarball rename, and Docker build steps before `frontguard run --docker`.

### Can I self-host the cloud?

The cloud source is MIT-licensed, but the Compose onboarding path is pre-release and is not currently a verified one-command setup.

### What env vars does Frontguard read?

`FRONTGUARD_OPENAI_KEY` / `FRONTGUARD_ANTHROPIC_KEY` for AI. `FRONTGUARD_API_URL` / `FRONTGUARD_API_KEY` for the cloud.

### Does Frontguard work with Storybook?

Yes. `frontguard init` detects `.storybook/main.ts` and scaffolds a Storybook-aware config. The adapter runs each story's `play()` function.

### Is there an MCP server?

`@frontguard/mcp` exposes `list_regressions`, `get_suggested_fix`, `accept_baseline`, `recent_runs`.

### Data retention?

Local CLI artifacts remain on your machine or Git baseline branch; AI inputs go to your configured provider. The pre-release cloud does not yet enforce general run/screenshot retention windows. See `docs/retention.md` for implemented behavior.
